info.title: API.SH: Ekşi Sözlük
info.description: The Ekşi Sözlük API from API.SH: public Ekşi Sözlük data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits

get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
An author's public profile: nick, rank and karma, avatar, bio, entry/follower/following counts, join month, badges with descriptions, and the entry pinned to their profile.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/eksisozluk-author

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.bio: street coder · sokak kodcusu · bluesky · ingilizce blog · ıvır zıvır · github · linkedin

get.description:
An author's latest entries or the entries they favourited (10 a page), each with its topic. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/eksisozluk-author-entries

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

One entry by its number: text, links, created and edited times, favourites, comment count, author and topic.

get.description:
The site's detailed topic search: words, author, date range, best entries only, and sort by date, title or entry count. Each topic has title, id, slug, URL and entry count (50 a page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/eksisozluk-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words in the topic (q or author is required).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: date (newest first, default), alphabetical or entries.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A topic's entries (10 a page) with the site's views: all in order, today's, best of the last 24 hours, best of all time, one day's, or one author's. Each entry has id, text, links, created and edited times, favourites, comment count and author (nick, id, avatar). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/eksisozluk-topic

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Topic as slug--id from its URL (e.g. besiktas--37894) or the full topic URL. Either topic or title is required.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Topic title, looked up the way the site's search box does (e.g. beşiktaş).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: all (oldest first, default), today, best_24h or best.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Only entries written on this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Only this author's entries in the topic (nick).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

entries.text: gitar calmak icin kullanilan minik plastik garip nesne.

get.description:
The site's topic lists (50 a page): agenda (gündem), today (bugün), unanswered (başıboşlar), one channel, or the topics of this day in an earlier year (tarihte bugün). Each topic has title, id, slug, URL and entry count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/eksisozluk-topics

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: With list=channel: the channel (e.g. spor, siyaset, bilim; see /eksisozluk/v1/channels).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: With list=on_this_day: the year (1999 or later, default last year).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
